---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
---

## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the feature should do.

## 🎯 Use Case
Describe the problem this feature would solve or the value it would provide.

### Example scenario:
```
As a [user/role], I want [feature], so that [benefit].
```

## 🔍 Acceptance Criteria
What should this feature accomplish? Define clear acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 📚 Implementation Approach
Describe how you think this should be implemented (optional):
- Technology/tools to use
- Files to create/modify
- API changes if applicable

## 🤝 Related Issues
Link to related issues, discussions, or PRs:
- Closes #123
- Related to #456

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any mockups, examples, or other context that might be useful.
